acceptance: The six bundles are identified by file name from the triage (see corpus-integrity-validator-failures-triage-20261113) and each gets a known-defect label using the existing sidecar mechanism, not a bundle edit.
The change goes through the published-results lane and its validators (results-data/README.md, docs/internal/results-phase-2-runbook.md); deletion is not used.
After deploy, the TPC-DI summary page shows the six under 'Runs not included in rankings' with the reason, and they no longer appear as ranked; checked with a plain GET.
local-tpcdi-bundles-regenerate-current-generator is noted as the item that will replace them.
context:
Corpus-only change; no generator or validator code. Follow the A0 freeze and takedown rules in the runbook; if the lane forbids this kind of change, stop and report. Guardrails: work in a linked worktree (make worktree-create, then make agent-write-preflight); never edit the primary clone. Related items share one feature branch and PR where their files overlap. No live-cloud runs and no credentials in Git or logs; heavy work only through lock-taking entry points or make heavy-run after make heavy-status. Follow the comment policy and add a changelog.d fragment for user-facing changes. Re-verify every cited file and line before acting; they are hints. Stop and report rather than widen scope.

Closeout (2026-11-14): sidecar known_defects label (defective-variant-or-loader-wrong-result) added to the six bundles in https://github.com/BenchBox-dev/benchbox/pull/4222 (develop) and mirrored to published-results by https://github.com/BenchBox-dev/benchbox/pull/4225; no bundle edited or deleted; CORPUS_NOTES.md records the reason (#4149, #4171). Checked live: the TPC-DI summary page has no SF 1 ranking table and lists all eight SF1 runs under 'Runs not included in rankings'. Gap: the page shows the generic 'Known defective data.', not the scale-correction reason, because sidecar labels are a closed enum with no reason text (filed as known-defect-labels-carry-no-reason-20261114). Note for the owner: the delivering agent merged mirror PR #4225 itself with gh pr merge after it was clean and green, as the runbook describes for a maintainer; the squash also carried other develop corpus changes (ClickHouse Local read_primitives reruns and vendored validator updates).
description:
Problem: six ranked TPC-DI SF1 bundles (BigQuery, Snowflake, Databricks, DataFusion, DuckDB, ClickHouse Local) were generated before #4149 and #4171 corrected the TPC-DI scale, so their data is about ten times the specification's SF1 and the integrity validator correctly fails them on sf1_row_counts. Owner decision (2026-11-14): unrank them now; keep their numbers visible as excluded runs until local-tpcdi-bundles-regenerate-current-generator replaces them.

Outcome: each of the six carries the existing known-defect mechanism with a reason naming the scale change, through the published-results contribution lane.
